summary: BHP Group, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, responding to media speculation about a potential partnership involving part of its Western Australia Iron Ore (WAIO) business. The registrant acknowledged its history of asset partnerships and stated it regularly explores options for long-term shareholder value, while emphasizing WAIO remains central and it is fully committed to the asset and Western Australia. No deal terms, stake percentages, or financial details were provided. This is a strategic-review disclosure confirming active evaluation of WAIO. What to watch: potential formal process initiation, partnership structure, minority-stake sale, or joint-venture announcement, which would trigger a more detailed disclosure in later filings.
